decisions.reason: As an improved, modular version of an already well-accepted trommel screen, it fits the firm's core range and after several years on the market would usually be continued rather than withdrawn.
Although more niche, the stationary electric fine shredder supports the company's move toward efficient, resource-saving stationary solutions, so management would more likely retain it than drop it.
This green-waste grinder variant serves established composting and biomass customers and, having survived beyond launch, is likely to remain in the portfolio unless replaced by a clearer successor.
A multi-model stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line is close to the firm's established shredding business and is therefore unlikely to be taken off the market in the coming year.
